about: ALTERNATE 1 of the film's music bed: the same take (Lyria 3.5, b2), cut more plainly. The groove runs through from 32 to 90 with ONE join (at 64, where the take's own second form begins, less its thin opening bars), so nothing in the music marks the cuts at 54 and 72; the take's own soft ending, with no added accent; no tone setting, so the take's own fuller bass (a limiter takes 5 dB off the highest peaks so that it sits at the same loudness as bed.wav under the same mix setting). Same level ride in shape. Remake: uv run --quiet demo-video/film/audio/music/tools/make_bed.py demo-video/film/audio/music/bed-alt-1.edl.json

source.measured_by: tools/beatfit.py fit: 119.9973 BPM, first bar line at 0.067 s, the beat wanders 1.5 ms at most over the take

segments.note: hook, reveal, and the main groove's first form whole (32-64): the take as the model wrote it, 64 s without a join
64-90: the groove's second form from its fourth bar (its thin opening bars left out)
morning: the dreamy part returns; its fill at 104-106
106-108: the take's own rise into its finale
planet: the take's finale; then its own soft last note and ring-out

gain_note: as bed.wav, but one step at 64 instead of the steps at 54 and 74, and the take's own soft last note lifted by 7 dB
peak_note: -3.3, not -1.5: at this peak its loudness over 32-90 equals bed.wav's (-15.9 LUFS), so mix.json needs no other change than the file name
